title: Immune landscape evaluation of NSCLC clinical samples
protocol: Collect formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded samples for histology.
Evaluate the collected FFPE samples with hematoxylin and eosin staining by a certified pathologist.
Construct tumor microarrays (TMAs) from 1.0 mm punches of the FFPE lung cancer blocks using a manual arrayer.
Perform immunohistochemistry (IHC) for PD-L1 on TMAs using the Ventana Benchmark Ultra system.
Pre-treat the tissue with Cell Conditioning 1 before IHC for PD-L1.
Incubate the section with anti-PD-L1 antibody at a dilution of 1:100.
Employ an OptiView DAB IHC Detection kit for detection in PD-L1 staining.
Perform immunohistochemistry (IHC) for CD3 and CD8 on TMAs using a PT-Link Module.
Pre-treat the tissue with high pH Envision FLEX Target retrieval solution before IHC for CD3 and CD8.
